```{r fit-models, include=FALSE}
# ===============================================================================
# Fit gamma models for CRP strategy across Model A, B, C
# ===============================================================================

model_formulas <- list(
  A = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp*Rx + tlr*Rx + tmb_braf*Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp*Rx + tlr*Rx + tmb_braf*Rx
  ),
  B = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tmb_braf + crp:Rx + tmb_braf:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tmb_braf + crp:Rx + tmb_braf:Rx
  ),
  C = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx
  )
)

# Helper for population-averaged predictions
predict_population_avg <- function(model, newdata, time_points) {
  tryCatch({
    pred <- predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "survival", times = time_points)
    if (".pred" %in% names(pred)) {
      surv_probs <- lapply(pred$.pred, function(x) x$.pred_survival)
      surv_matrix <- do.call(cbind, surv_probs)
      return(rowMeans(surv_matrix, na.rm = TRUE))
    } else if (is.list(pred) && length(pred) > 0 && is.data.frame(pred[[1]])) {
      surv_probs <- sapply(pred, function(x) x$est)
      if (is.matrix(surv_probs)) {
        return(rowMeans(surv_probs, na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        return(surv_probs)
      }
    } else {
      return(NULL)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Fit models and generate base-case predictions
fitted_models <- list()
base_predictions <- list()

for (model_name in names(model_formulas)) {
  fitted_models[[model_name]] <- list()
  base_predictions[[model_name]] <- list()

  for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
    formula <- model_formulas[[model_name]][[outcome]]
    fitted_models[[model_name]][[outcome]] <- tryCatch(
      flexsurvreg(formula = formula, data = data_complete, dist = "gamma"),
      error = function(e) { message("Failed to fit ", model_name, " ", outcome); NULL }
    )
  }

  if (is.null(fitted_models[[model_name]]$os) || is.null(fitted_models[[model_name]]$pfs)) next

  # Control predictions (all patients, control treatment)
  control_data <- data_complete
  control_data$Rx <- factor(ctrl_rx, levels = levels(data_complete$Rx))

  for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
    base_predictions[[model_name]][[paste0("control_", outcome)]] <-
      predict_population_avg(fitted_models[[model_name]][[outcome]], control_data, time_points)
  }

  # CRP-weighted predictions
  crp_pos_data <- data_complete[as.numeric(as.character(data_complete$crp)) == 1, ]
  crp_pos_data$Rx <- factor(exp_rx, levels = levels(data_complete$Rx))

  crp_neg_data <- data_complete[as.numeric(as.character(data_complete$crp)) == 0, ]
  crp_neg_data$Rx <- factor(ctrl_rx, levels = levels(data_complete$Rx))

  for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
    pos_pred <- predict_population_avg(fitted_models[[model_name]][[outcome]], crp_pos_data, time_points)
    neg_pred <- predict_population_avg(fitted_models[[model_name]][[outcome]], crp_neg_data, time_points)

    if (!is.null(pos_pred) && !is.null(neg_pred)) {
      base_predictions[[model_name]][[paste0("crp_", outcome)]] <-
        crp_prev * pos_pred + (1 - crp_prev) * neg_pred
    }
  }
}

cat("Base-case predictions generated for models:",
    paste(names(base_predictions), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r bootstrap-ci, include=FALSE}
# ===============================================================================
# Load sampling caches and compute 95% bootstrap CIs
# ===============================================================================

model_structure_labels <- c(A = "joint", B = "focused", C = "separate")
n_boot_subset <- 500  # Subset of 5000 for speed

ci_data <- list()

for (model_name in names(model_structure_labels)) {
  model_label <- model_structure_labels[model_name]

  # Try to find cache file
  cache_pattern <- here("data", "tidy",
    paste0("sampling_models_n", n_samples, "_full_", model_label, ".rds"))

  if (!file.exists(cache_pattern)) {
    cat("Sampling cache not found for", model_label, "- skipping bootstrap CI\n")
    next
  }

  cat("Loading sampling cache for", model_label, "...\n")
  sampling_models_cache <- readRDS(cache_pattern)

  n_available <- min(n_boot_subset, sampling_models_cache$crp$n_samples)
  boot_indices <- sample(seq_len(sampling_models_cache$crp$n_samples), n_available)

  ci_data[[model_name]] <- list()

  for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
    # Storage for bootstrap predictions
    control_boot <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(time_points), ncol = n_available)
    crp_boot <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(time_points), ncol = n_available)

    for (j in seq_along(boot_indices)) {
      idx <- boot_indices[j]

      # Control predictions from control sampling model
      ctrl_model <- sampling_models_cache$control$samples[[idx]][[outcome]]$model
      if (!is.null(ctrl_model)) {
        ctrl_data_tmp <- data_complete
        ctrl_data_tmp$Rx <- factor(ctrl_rx, levels = levels(data_complete$Rx))
        ctrl_pred <- tryCatch(
          predict_population_avg(ctrl_model, ctrl_data_tmp, time_points),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (!is.null(ctrl_pred)) control_boot[, j] <- ctrl_pred
      }

      # CRP-weighted predictions from CRP sampling model
      crp_model <- sampling_models_cache$crp$samples[[idx]][[outcome]]$model
      if (!is.null(crp_model)) {
        crp_pos_tmp <- data_complete[as.numeric(as.character(data_complete$crp)) == 1, ]
        crp_pos_tmp$Rx <- factor(exp_rx, levels = levels(data_complete$Rx))
        crp_neg_tmp <- data_complete[as.numeric(as.character(data_complete$crp)) == 0, ]
        crp_neg_tmp$Rx <- factor(ctrl_rx, levels = levels(data_complete$Rx))

        pos_pred <- tryCatch(
          predict_population_avg(crp_model, crp_pos_tmp, time_points),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        neg_pred <- tryCatch(
          predict_population_avg(crp_model, crp_neg_tmp, time_points),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )

        if (!is.null(pos_pred) && !is.null(neg_pred)) {
          crp_boot[, j] <- crp_prev * pos_pred + (1 - crp_prev) * neg_pred
        }
      }

      if (j %% 100 == 0) cat("  ", model_name, outcome, ":", j, "/", n_available, "\n")
    }

    # Compute percentile CIs
    ci_data[[model_name]][[paste0("control_", outcome, "_lower")]] <-
      apply(control_boot, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
    ci_data[[model_name]][[paste0("control_", outcome, "_upper")]] <-
      apply(control_boot, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
    ci_data[[model_name]][[paste0("crp_", outcome, "_lower")]] <-
      apply(crp_boot, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
    ci_data[[model_name]][[paste0("crp_", outcome, "_upper")]] <-
      apply(crp_boot, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # Free memory
  rm(sampling_models_cache)
  gc()

  cat("Bootstrap CIs computed for", model_name, "\n")
}

has_ci <- length(ci_data) > 0
cat("Bootstrap CI available:", has_ci, "\n")
```

```{r km-data, include=FALSE}
# ===============================================================================
# Compute Kaplan-Meier curves from observed data
# ===============================================================================

# Control arm KM (all patients in control arm)
data_control <- data_complete[data_complete$Rx == ctrl_rx, ]

km_control_os <- survfit(Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ 1, data = data_control)
km_control_pfs <- survfit(Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ 1, data = data_control)

# CRP-guided strategy KM: CRP+ patients from experimental arm + CRP- from control arm
# This is the observed analog of biomarker-guided treatment assignment
data_crp_guided <- rbind(
  data_complete[as.numeric(as.character(data_complete$crp)) == 1 &
                data_complete$Rx == exp_rx, ],
  data_complete[as.numeric(as.character(data_complete$crp)) == 0 &
                data_complete$Rx == ctrl_rx, ]
)

km_crp_os <- survfit(Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ 1, data = data_crp_guided)
km_crp_pfs <- survfit(Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ 1, data = data_crp_guided)

# Helper to extract KM data for ggplot
extract_km_data <- function(km_fit) {
  data.frame(
    time = km_fit$time,
    surv = km_fit$surv,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

km_data_list <- list(
  control_os = extract_km_data(km_control_os),
  control_pfs = extract_km_data(km_control_pfs),
  crp_os = extract_km_data(km_crp_os),
  crp_pfs = extract_km_data(km_crp_pfs)
)

cat("KM curves computed. Control arm:", nrow(data_control), "patients.",
    "CRP-guided:", nrow(data_crp_guided), "patients.\n")
```

```{r create-panels, include=FALSE}
# ===============================================================================
# Build individual panels: 3 models x 2 outcomes
# ===============================================================================

model_display <- c(A = "Model A", B = "Model B", C = "Model C")
strategy_colors <- c("Control" = "gray50", "CRP Strategy" = "#E69F00")

create_survival_panel <- function(model_name, outcome, show_legend = FALSE) {
  outcome_label <- if (outcome == "os") "Overall Survival" else "Progression-Free Survival"
  km_ctrl_key <- paste0("control_", outcome)
  km_crp_key <- paste0("crp_", outcome)
  pred_ctrl_key <- paste0("control_", outcome)
  pred_crp_key <- paste0("crp_", outcome)

  # Build plot data: parametric base-case curves
  plot_df <- data.frame()

  ctrl_pred <- base_predictions[[model_name]][[pred_ctrl_key]]
  crp_pred <- base_predictions[[model_name]][[pred_crp_key]]

  if (!is.null(ctrl_pred)) {
    plot_df <- rbind(plot_df, data.frame(
      time = time_points, surv = ctrl_pred, group = "Control"))
  }
  if (!is.null(crp_pred)) {
    plot_df <- rbind(plot_df, data.frame(
      time = time_points, surv = crp_pred, group = "CRP Strategy"))
  }

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  p <- ggplot()

  # Layer 1: Bootstrap CI ribbon (if available)
  if (model_name %in% names(ci_data)) {
    ci <- ci_data[[model_name]]

    ctrl_lower <- ci[[paste0("control_", outcome, "_lower")]]
    ctrl_upper <- ci[[paste0("control_", outcome, "_upper")]]
    crp_lower <- ci[[paste0("crp_", outcome, "_lower")]]
    crp_upper <- ci[[paste0("crp_", outcome, "_upper")]]

    if (!is.null(ctrl_lower) && !all(is.na(ctrl_lower))) {
      ci_ctrl_df <- data.frame(time = time_points, lower = ctrl_lower, upper = ctrl_upper)
      p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = ci_ctrl_df, aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                           fill = "gray50", alpha = 0.15)
    }
    if (!is.null(crp_lower) && !all(is.na(crp_lower))) {
      ci_crp_df <- data.frame(time = time_points, lower = crp_lower, upper = crp_upper)
      p <- p + geom_ribbon(data = ci_crp_df, aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                           fill = "#E69F00", alpha = 0.15)
    }
  }

  # Layer 2: Parametric base-case curves (solid lines)
  p <- p +
    geom_line(data = plot_df, aes(x = time, y = surv, color = group), linewidth = 0.8)

  # Layer 3: KM overlay (step functions)
  km_ctrl <- km_data_list[[km_ctrl_key]]
  km_crp <- km_data_list[[km_crp_key]]

  if (!is.null(km_ctrl) && nrow(km_ctrl) > 0) {
    km_ctrl$group <- "Control"
    p <- p + geom_step(data = km_ctrl, aes(x = time, y = surv, color = group),
                       linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7)
  }
  if (!is.null(km_crp) && nrow(km_crp) > 0) {
    km_crp$group <- "CRP Strategy"
    p <- p + geom_step(data = km_crp, aes(x = time, y = surv, color = group),
                       linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7)
  }

  # Formatting
  p <- p +
    scale_color_manual(values = strategy_colors, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, max(time_points), by = 104),
      labels = function(x) x / 52
    ) +
    labs(x = "Time (years)", y = outcome_label,
         title = model_display[model_name]) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  if (show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                   legend.text = element_text(size = 8))
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }

  return(p)
}

# Generate all 6 panels
panels <- list()
for (model_name in c("A", "B", "C")) {
  for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
    key <- paste0(model_name, "_", outcome)
    panels[[key]] <- create_survival_panel(model_name, outcome, show_legend = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r combined-figure, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Extract a shared legend from one panel
legend_panel <- create_survival_panel("A", "os", show_legend = TRUE)
shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_panel)

# Assemble 3 columns x 2 rows grid
plot_grid_main <- plot_grid(
  panels$A_os, panels$B_os, panels$C_os,
  panels$A_pfs, panels$B_pfs, panels$C_pfs,
  ncol = 3, nrow = 2,
  labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"),
  label_size = 14
)

# Add shared legend at bottom
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid_main, shared_legend,
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.05)
)

print(combined_plot)
```
